title: resourceWorkers
responsibility: Bounds test and native worker concurrency by the managed CPU reservation and partitions memory for child workers.

inputs.name: resourceWorkers.env
inputs.description: Resource and caller environment used to resolve paths or bounded worker settings; unrelated credentials are not newly propagated.

inputs.name: resourceWorkers.maximumWorkers
inputs.description: Optional caller ceiling of at least one worker; the default keeps the reservation-derived limit. Memory is divided by the actual capped worker count.

inputs.name: resourceThreads.env
inputs.description: Resource and caller environment used to resolve paths or bounded worker settings; unrelated credentials are not newly propagated.

outputs.name: resourceWorkers
outputs.type: { maxWorkers?: number; minWorkers?: number; env?: Record<string, string>; }
outputs.description: Vitest worker limits and child CPU, memory and native-thread environment; empty without a valid reservation.

outputs.name: resourceThreads
outputs.description: Native thread variables capped by the CPU reservation while retaining stricter caller values.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an invalid caller worker ceiling instead of returning an unusable worker configuration.
